headline: Google's Gemini 4 Neon undercuts rivals on price and speed
dek: It sits between Carbon and Hydrogen, per Google DeepMind.

s2.label: What happened
s2.title: The launch
body: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, a model placed between Carbon and Hydrogen, per Google DeepMind.
The company says it runs about three times faster than Carbon at 60% lower cost (SiliconANGLE).

s4.label: Why it matters
s4.title: In the ranking
body: On Artificial Analysis, Neon scored 61 points and placed third overall (SiliconANGLE).
It trails Claude Fable 5.2, at 65, and GPT-6.2 Astra, at 62 (SiliconANGLE).

items.t: A cybersecurity version, with limited access.
API and Gemini for Business for paying users.

caption.hook: Google launched Gemini 4 Neon, a fast, lower-priced model aimed at businesses.
body: Per Google DeepMind, Neon sits between Carbon, the most powerful, and Hydrogen, the cheapest. SiliconANGLE reports it runs about three times faster than Carbon at 60% lower cost per task, and costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens.

On Artificial Analysis, Neon scored 61 points and placed third, behind Claude Fable 5.2 and GPT-6.2 Astra, per SiliconANGLE. The context window reaches 1 million tokens, and a cybersecurity version will have limited access, per Olhar Digital IA.
caption.cta: Would a cheaper, faster model change your AI budget?
